observations: The caller loads AL from the device parameter block before invoking the guarded routine.
The guarded routine conditionally jumps to file 0x194f2.
The destination checks dirty-buffer state, scans buffers and returns carry according to FAILERR; this corresponds structurally to historical FlushBuf.
The provisional external name in the research source was changed to FlushBufGuarded; isolated reassembly retains identical code bytes.
limitations: The precise meaning of the guard at offset 0x16467 is not yet established.
